queries: LLM "say-do" gap stated versus actual behavior agents study

sources_considered.why: It finds gaps between the beliefs LLMs state and how they act in trust-game role-play. That is a gap between an LLM's own words and its own actions. It does not compare imitating human speech with replicating human actions.
It studies how faithfully agents act on their own stated reasoning. This does not match the claim's comparison with human speech and action.

unresolved_gaps: No matched study was found that scores LLMs on imitating what humans say versus what humans do in the same situations, using one common metric.
